question: Choose the antonym of 'benevolent":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Malevolent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"benevolent"** means someone who is kind, generous, and well-meaning; showing goodwill and a desire to help others. (दयालु, शुभचिंतक)

 
 
• **Example: **The benevolent teacher always supported her students in every possible way.
 
 
 
• **"Malevolent"** refers to someone who is spiteful, malicious, or harboring ill intentions towards others; wishing harm or evil. (दुर्भावनापूर्ण, द्वेषपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The villain in the story was malevolent and tried to harm the protagonist at every turn.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'benevolent'** is **'malevolent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Malevolent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Humane **(मानवीय): Showing kindness, compassion, or concern for others, especially for those who are suffering.

 
 
• **Example:** The humane treatment of animals is essential in today’s world.
 
 
 
• **Generous **(उदार): Willing to give or share more than is necessary or expected.
 
 
• **Example:** He is known for being generous with his wealth and time.
 
 
 
• **Kind **(दयालु): Being considerate, caring, and helpful towards others.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always kind to strangers and goes out of her way to help them.
